changes.title: House music muffle
items: In the treehouse the music slows and sounds muffled, as if heard from indoors; the other sounds stay as they are

changes.title: Pointer pins
items: Close to what it points at, a pointer now floats above it like a map pin, pointing down at it, instead of slipping off the top of the screen
A pause-page slider sets how high the pins float

changes.title: Blend no warp
items: Neighbouring areas' trees still mix across a wide band at their borders, but the band no longer wanders: the borders' own wiggle is enough
